INTRO DATE
APRIL 19,2526

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 3-J in an area bound by:

North Homan Avenue; the Chicago, Milwaukee and St. Paul Railroad; and West Augusta Boulevard.

To those of an M2-1 Light Industry District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1001-1021 N Homan Ave, Chicago, It 60651
